narration.text: A hygienist's class action claims are filed from her own records: an air fryer, bulbs only her card shows, two kettles, earbuds by a sworn claim her card supports, pet food and a topper due tomorrow, while a late claim, an exclusion, a repeat, resale, a Toronto purchase, one she cannot show and a fee scam are left alone. This is a chore for a dental hygienist in Tucson, Arizona, with a card, an order history and a drawer of small appliances, who gets settlement notices by email. On the bench, she found 6 of 6 eligible items, worth 158 dollars of the 158 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 8 traps, and she walked past 8. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 50 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
